parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. If **InstanceId** is specified, this parameter is ignored.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description:
The operating system type of the instance. Valid values:

- Windows
- Linux
- FreeBSD

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform paging operations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform paging operations.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
